Is it really free?

Yes. The class, the Q&A, the replay and the workbook are all free.

Script 1 · “Familiar vs safe”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why the brain can confuse familiar with safe.”

Body

“Early relationships teach the nervous system what love feels like. So later, the partner who feels exciting can simply be the one who feels familiar. The good news: the brain keeps learning. Secure attachment can be practised.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the science and three daily actions in a free 60-minute masterclass. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “familiar ≠ safe”. Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 2 · “Green flags”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three early signs of a secure partner that are easy to miss.”

Body

“Consistency can feel boring at first. Clear plans can feel too simple. Calm can feel unfamiliar. In the masterclass I explain why, from a neuroscience point of view, and how to notice the pull towards the old pattern.”

CTA

“The Secure Love Masterclass is free, live and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, three numbered text cards.

Script 3 · “Science and action”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Knowing an attachment style doesn’t change it. This does.”

Body

“Quizzes and books give information. The brain changes through repetition. That’s why I teach science and action together: small daily habits that build a more secure way of relating.”

CTA

“I’ll walk through three of those habits in a free live class. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to slide with the 3 habits listed.
